about: What the least program that shows three dimensions on a page weighs (tools/ci/mesh-web-size.sh): omui.size.yard built for wasm32-emscripten as a release is (-O2), its bytes as shipped (the names section left out). Bytes.

budgets.why: 610,306 B (2026-11-14): code 389,264 — the standard library 42%, the page's two devices 9%, mlibs.rhi 7%, the mesh pass 5.5%, geometry 5% — and data 216,217, most of it the pass's shaders as WGSL and as ESSL.
